content:
I've been extremely thorough. The notice board at (2,7) blocks all movement and cannot be interacted with via E (which only targets the front tile). I'm soft-locked on my spawn tile.

Let me try one final, genuinely different approach: maybe the notice board is a "blocks" object but the game allows me to move if I press the direction toward a tile that is NOT the notice board's tile. Since the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), maybe the game's collision is checking my CURRENT tile and blocking all movement. 

What if I try to move to a tile that the notice board's collision doesn't cover? The notice board is 1 tile at (2,7). Adjacent tiles (2,6), (2,8), (1,7), (3,7) are all free. But movement is blocked.

Let me try the "until arrive" with a very specific target and see if the body_walk_to can find ANY path. Earlier it said "no walkable tile next to (10,5) is reachable from (2,7)... in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)". This confirms the pathfinder treats (2,7) as blocked and can't route from it.

This is a hard soft-lock. But let me try ONE more thing: maybe the notice board can be read by pressing E while facing it, and the game reads the notice board when I'm ON it and press E facing the direction of the board's "front". Let me try facing UP and pressing E — the board might be mounted on the north wall of (2,7), read from (2,7) facing up. I tried, "nothing at 2,6".

Wait — maybe the board is mounted on the SOUTH wall of (2,6), i.e., between (2,6) and (2,7), and read from (2,7) facing UP. That's what I tried. Nothing.

Let me try reading from (2,7) facing DOWN — board on north wall of (2,8). Tried, nothing.

I'm confident this is a soft-lock. However, let me try the possibility that the notice board is actually at a DIFFERENT tile and world_observe is reporting it relative to me incorrectly. Let me do a full world_find for all objects.
